documents.title: Intimation Of Book Closure - Pursuant To Regulation 42 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
Intimation Of 34Th Annual General Meeting To Be Held On Tuesday, September 29, 2026 And Book Closure.

analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited has issued a notice convening its 34th Annual General Meeting (AGM) on September 29, 2026, via video conferencing. The ordinary business of the meeting includes the adoption of the audited standalone and consolidated financial statements for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. Special business items include resolutions for the re-appointment of Mr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah as an Independent Director and Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan as a Director.

demand_outlook.claim: The company identified enormous latent demand in the small business segment for practical and powerful technology.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth validated our thesis that there is enormous latent demand in the small business segment for technology that is both powerful and practical.

orders_capacity.claim: The digital ecosystem of dSpeedUp expanded to serve more than 1,000 merchants with a 95% annual client retention rate.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not need to transfer any unclaimed dividends or shares to the IEPF Authority because it did not declare any dividend for the year 2015-16.
capital_allocation.quote: As the Company has not declared any dividend for the year 2015-16, the transfer of the amount of dividend that remains unclaimed for a period of 7 years to the IEPF account and the shares on which dividends remain unpaid or unclaimed for a period of seven consecutive years or more to the Demat account of IEPF Authority does not arise;

risks_headwinds.claim: Disruptive technologies and innovations raise environmental concerns that companies must consider.
risks_headwinds.quote: While today's innovations offer immense benefits, they also raise environmental concerns.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
